title: SAP Agent Context consultant-answer layer
wedge: A deterministic, citation-bound SAP consultant-answer layer over local evidence; not a generic SAP chatbot, LLM answer generator, documentation mirror, or tenant-truth oracle.
north_star: SAP professionals and their agents can ask bounded SAP implementation questions and receive compact, source-labelled consultant-style answers that are useful when evidence exists and explicitly fail closed when it does not.
desired_outcome: Turn SAP Agent Context from a strong retrieval/context repository into a practical local answer contract where every ready answer is backed by class-specific citations, visible boundaries, adversarial fixtures, and no false tenant/release/customizing certainty.
target_user_audience: AI agents helping SAP professionals draft or review functional design context
SAP consultants who need quick local evidence-backed starting answers
Repo maintainers deciding which SAP domain slices are mature enough for deterministic answers
painful_moment: The repo can retrieve useful SAP context, but a user or downstream agent still needs to know whether a direct consultant-style answer is safe, cited, and bounded enough to use as a starting point.
core_promise: Ask a supported SAP scenario question; get a compact answer with citations and explicit live-web, expert-certification and tenant-specific-truth boundaries. Ask an unsupported or generic question; get needs_curation instead of SAP-sounding filler.
principles: Answer generation is deterministic and extractive before any LLM synthesis is considered.
Ready status requires class-specific citeable support, not just any top-k source and claim.
Every new ready intent needs positive fixtures, nearby negative/adversarial probes, and answer-specific citation checks.
Unsupported, generic, tenant-specific, release-specific, or customizing-specific questions fail closed with an actionable curation boundary.
Citations are part of the product surface; noisy or unrelated evidence is a correctness bug, even if the answer text sounds right.
Keep examples and generated proof machine-readable JSON/JSONL first; Markdown remains narrative maintainer context only.
non_goals: Do not add an LLM/free-form answer generator before deterministic evidence binding is mature.
Do not bulk-import SAP Help or turn the repo into a SAP documentation mirror.
Do not claim tenant availability, target workflow configuration, release currentness, authorizations, or customizing values from generic/public context.

Do not promote broad/generic questions such as 'API report', 'How should API reporting work?', 'What is release strategy?' or 'Welke SAP modules zijn er?' to ready without a source-backed answer contract.
Do not use item count, broad keyword matches, or any citeable top-5 result as maturity proof.
Do not hide generated-answer evidence only in Markdown examples.

load_bearing_assumptions.claim: Deterministic templates can cover high-value SAP scenario answers before LLM synthesis is needed.
load_bearing_assumptions.fails_if: Users primarily ask broad, compound, or tenant-specific questions that templates cannot answer without sounding artificial or evasive.
load_bearing_assumptions.cheapest_test: Add 10 representative user-style consultant-answer fixtures across supported and unsupported questions; inspect whether ready/needs_curation matches human expectation.
load_bearing_assumptions.kill_or_pivot: If more than 30% of representative supported questions need free-form reasoning beyond retrieved evidence, pivot to a stricter retrieval-bundle plus optional LLM-consumer contract instead of expanding templates.

load_bearing_assumptions.claim: Class-specific evidence binding is sufficient to prevent noisy citation bugs for supported intents.
load_bearing_assumptions.fails_if: Ready answers still cite unrelated domain/app/access-policy records after support-id filtering and answer-specific citation checks.
load_bearing_assumptions.cheapest_test: For every new classifier, run direct CLI probes and assert required_answer_citation_ids in evaluate-consultant-answers.
load_bearing_assumptions.kill_or_pivot: If support-id lists become too brittle or large, move support profiles into a data-driven ranking/answer-profile schema before adding more domains.

load_bearing_assumptions.claim: Nearby negative probes can keep classifier boundaries honest enough for deterministic ready status.
load_bearing_assumptions.fails_if: Generic prompts with shared keywords are repeatedly promoted to ready by broad trigger words.
load_bearing_assumptions.cheapest_test: Maintain adversarial tests for generic API/reporting/release/workflow/module prompts whenever a classifier changes.
load_bearing_assumptions.kill_or_pivot: If boundary regressions recur, require classifiers to use retrieved support profiles plus explicit intent patterns rather than keyword pairs alone.

load_bearing_assumptions.claim: The next valuable product step is deeper answer contracts, not broader SAP content coverage.
load_bearing_assumptions.fails_if: Gap reports show important answer failures are caused by missing source-labelled records rather than answer-layer/evaluator weakness.
load_bearing_assumptions.cheapest_test: Run curation-report and consultant-answer evaluation, then classify failures as missing evidence, ranking, classifier, template, or evaluator gaps.
load_bearing_assumptions.kill_or_pivot: If missing evidence dominates, pause answer-template expansion and run a bounded knowledge/domain-pack curation slice first.

load_bearing_assumptions.claim: Public-safe local answer artifacts can be useful without copying proprietary SAP text.
load_bearing_assumptions.fails_if: Useful answers require copied SAP documentation, tenant screenshots, internal URLs, customer mappings, or gated SAP Notes/KBA content.
load_bearing_assumptions.cheapest_test: Review every new ready fixture for public-safe source pointers, access labels, and no tenant/customer/proprietary content.
load_bearing_assumptions.kill_or_pivot: If public-safe pointers are insufficient for a domain, mark it gated/needs_curation and require authorized human verification rather than shipping ready answers.

success_metrics: evaluate-consultant-answers passes with answer-specific citation checks for every ready scenario.
Every new ready classifier has at least one positive fixture and at least two nearby negative/adversarial probes.
Ready answers cite only classification-support records or explicitly required answer citation IDs for the scenario.
Generic unsupported prompts remain needs_curation in tests and direct CLI probes.
make check and make audit-v02-gap-report stay green after each slice.
No public-safety scan or review finds tenant URLs, credentials, customer data, screenshots, SAP exports, or copied proprietary documentation.
verification_strategy: Focused RED probes before each classifier/template expansion.
schema/answer-scenario-fixtures.yaml positive and negative scenario coverage.
tests/test_consultant_answer.py for classification, status, citation, and adversarial boundary behavior.
evaluate-answer-scenarios for retrieval/evidence readiness, separate from evaluate-consultant-answers for generated-answer proof.
Direct CLI smoke: consultant-answer for supported prompts and nearby generic prompts.
Full gate: make check, make audit-v02-gap-report, git diff --check before ship.

first_proof.statement: The newly expanded consultant-answer layer proves the pattern for three domains when answer citations are bound to classification-specific support and generic nearby prompts remain needs_curation.
current_evidence: commit 5d3f04c expanded ready coverage to integration_security, analytics_extensibility, and procurement_workflow
make check passed with 297 pytest tests
adversarial probes API report, How should API reporting work, and What is release strategy returned needs_curation generic
first_proof.next_required_proof: Repeat the same evidence-binding pattern for one additional high-value domain or convert support profiles to data-driven schema if classifier/support lists become brittle.

first_build_slices.summary: Move CLASSIFICATION_SUPPORT_IDS, classifier triggers, required answer citations, and negative probes into a data-driven answer-profile schema if the next domain repeats hardcoded patterns.
Add a compact debug surface showing why a consultant-answer was ready/needs_curation, which support IDs were retained, and which required citation IDs passed or failed.
Add optional public source verification for answer scenarios without making network availability part of default make check.

Promote one next high-value domain only if it can satisfy positive fixtures, answer-specific citation IDs, nearby negative probes, and fail-closed templates. Candidate domains: EAM/PM lifecycle or migration cockpit.
Add JSON examples showing how downstream agents should consume status, answer, citations, evidence, and boundary fields without treating ready as tenant truth.

open_questions: Should answer-profile configuration move to schema/ before the next domain expansion, or only after one more hardcoded slice proves repeated structure?
Which downstream consumer should define the minimum answer artifact contract: local CLI users, McCoy FO Generator v2, or generic agent workflows?
Should source verification be a release-only command, a soft Make target, or a separate reviewer workflow?
What is the next domain with enough existing evidence to deserve ready answers without broad new content import?

decision_log.decision: Keep consultant-answer deterministic/extractive and fail-closed rather than adding LLM generation.
decision_log.reason: The repo's differentiator is local, evidence-backed SAP context with explicit source and tenant boundaries.

decision_log.decision: Bind ready answer evidence to class-specific support IDs and answer-specific citation requirements.
decision_log.reason: A pre-ship review found that green retrieval gates could still produce ready answers citing noisy or unrelated evidence.

decision_log.decision: Generic API/reporting/release-strategy prompts stay needs_curation unless they contain explicit supported intent and evidence anchors.
decision_log.reason: Broad trigger words are too easy to over-promote and create false certainty.

next_planning_boundary: Run go-plan only for one bounded next slice: answer-profile schema spike, query-explain answer debug, source-verification soft gate, or next-domain ready slice. Do not create broad SAP-content tasks from this vision.
